business_rule.description: Tenant scoping trait applied to operational models
Global scope filtering queries by tenant_id
Redirects locked tenants to billing except billing routes
Resolves tenant context for Sanctum API requests
Idempotency guard for API write endpoints
Recalculates student invoice status from payments
Creates draft invoice morph-linked to Applicant on acceptance
JSONLogic evaluation for workflow transition conditions
Restricts mutations on global resources for non-super-admins
CSRF exceptions and middleware aliases including subscription.active
